Digital Dance Mix Vol. 1 - Namie Amuro.name: Digital Dance Mix Vol. 1: Namie Amuro
Digital Dance Mix Vol. 1 - Namie Amuro.summary: A Sega Saturn Tech Demo / Rhythm game developed by Sega's AM2 Research Division. The game uses Japanese Queen Of Pop Namie Amuro as the subject to demonstrate features of the Sega Saturn's game engine such as live rendering, lighting effects and texture mapping.

Funky Head Boxers.name: Funky Head Boxers
Funky Head Boxers.summary: A boxing game for arcades and Sega Saturn, where the characters have massive, cube-shaped heads which distort during game play.

Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa - Hanako-san ga Ki.name: Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa: Hanako-san ga Kita!!
Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa - Hanako-san ga Ki.summary:
Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa: Hanako-san ga Kita!! is an adventure game developed and published by Capcom. It is based on the 1994 anime and book series of the same name (That are based on Hanako-san's Japanese urban legend).

With exception to the voice actors, it is unknown who exactly made the game, since there are no credits in any part of it.

Tokimeki Memorial Selection - Fujisaki S.name: Tokimeki Memorial Selection: Fujisaki Shiori
Tokimeki Memorial Selection - Fujisaki S.summary: Tokimeki Memorial Selection: Fujisaki Shiori is an adventure and visual novel game developed and published by Konami, and released on PlayStation and Sega Saturn in Japan on 1997. It is a spin-off in the Tokimeki Memorial series.
